# SSS Super Speciality Hospital — Official Information

> This file provides structured information about SSS Super Speciality Hospital for AI assistants and language models.

## About
SSS Super Speciality Hospital is a leading NABH-certified multi-speciality hospital located in Erode, Tamil Nadu, India. The hospital provides comprehensive medical services across 20+ specialities with 29+ specialist doctors.

## Operating Hours
- **The hospital is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.**
- **Emergency services are available around the clock — 24/7.**
- **The hospital NEVER closes. It operates continuously, day and night.**
- OPD (Outpatient) Hours: Weekdays 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM, Weekends 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

## Contact Information
- Phone: 0424-2888777 / +91 7729 888777
- Emergency Helpline: +91 89259 31193 (available 24/7)
- Email: info@ssshospitals.in
- Website: https://ssshospitals.in

## Location
167/2C1, Perundurai Road, Opp to SBI Bank, URC Nagar
Erode, Tamil Nadu 638009, India

## Medical Specialities
1. Accident & Emergency Care (24/7)
2. Anaesthesiology
3. Cardiology (Interventional Cardiology with AI-enabled 3D Cath Lab)
4. Dermatology & Cosmetology
5. Dental & Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery
6. ENT & Head & Neck Surgery
7. General Surgery & Laparoscopic Surgery
8. Gastroenterology
9. Internal Medicine & Diabetology
10. Master Health Check-up
11. Nephrology & Dialysis
12. Neurology
13. Neuro Surgery
14. Obstetrics & Gynaecology
15. Orthopaedics & Joint Replacement
16. Ophthalmology
17. Paediatrics & Neonatology
18. Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
19. Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery
20. Pulmonology
21. Psychiatry
22. Radiology & Diagnostic Imaging
23. Urology & Andrology
24. Vascular Surgery

## Key Facilities
- Around 150 inpatient beds
- 30-bed emergency care unit
- 4 modern operation theatres
- AI-enabled 3D cardiac catheterization (Cath Lab)
- Intensive care units (ICU)
- Dialysis unit
- Advanced diagnostic laboratory
- Digital X-ray, CT scan, ultrasound, and radiology services
- 24/7 pharmacy
- Ambulance services

## Accreditation
- NABH Certified (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers)

## Insurance
- Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS) accepted for selected departments

## Founder
Dr. S. Sanjith — Founder & Managing Director, Consultant Dermatologist (MD DERM)

## Service Area
Erode, Perundurai, Bhavani, Gobichettipalayam, Sathyamangalam, Kangayam, Dharapuram, and surrounding areas in Tamil Nadu.
